How Scoring Works

Paint one section at a time

Choose any of the 12 tiles. Your work is saved independently, so you can finish one section today and return to another later.

Three-part visual score

Your score combines color similarity, light-and-dark value similarity, and edge or shape structure. The comparison is resized before analysis so it rewards the overall visual relationships rather than exact brush texture.

Earn points by improving

Your first saved attempt earns a completion bonus. After that, points come from beating your personal best, which encourages careful observation rather than repeating easy attempts.

Build the complete painting

Every saved tile is placed into your growing copy of the masterpiece. Complete all 12 sections to earn a full-painting bonus and unlock more artwork.

Drag to choose a color

Move your finger around the enlarged tile. Release to select and return to Brush.
